UNSUPPORTED: "Mercedes hizo una sola parada, mientras que Leclerc y Hamilton hicieron dos con Ferrari" (Source says Antonelli ran a one-stop and Ferrari ran a two-stop strategy. It does not say Mercedes as a team ran one stop. Change to say Antonelli made one stop.)
UNSUPPORTED: "FAQ: 'Marco Antonelli es un ex piloto de carreras'" (Same as body: former racing driver status not stated in sources.)
